source.title: Top Gainer in the Market is +2,493% TODAY!

symbol_correction.reason: The listed security YOLO is incompatible with the recap. A retrospective market-wide raw-SIP audit found YOUL rejecting at exactly $5.20 at 07:20 ET and reaching $8.27 five minutes later. A point-in-time SEC filing reports 64,887,792 Class A ordinary shares as of July 9, 2025, closely matching the recap's approximate 64 million share figure.

point_in_time_filing.interpretation: The Class A count corroborates the recap's approximate 64M scanner figure; it is not asserted here to be a formal free-float calculation.

research_notes: This is a boundary case for upstream stock selection, execution/no-fill behavior and discretionary skip logic, not a primary Micro v0.1 setup score.
The transcript-derived YOLO ticker was corrected to YOUL only in the retrospective evidence layer; no identity-audit price or share-count fact may be supplied to runtime replay.
The fact that price later went higher must not retroactively convert the skipped/no-fill behavior into a strategy error.
The behavioral labels were not changed to fit any runtime policy.
